title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Exodus 32: the golden calf, Moses' prayer for the people, the broken tablets and the sons of Levi.

questions.text: Why did the people gather to Aaron and ask him to make them gods?
questions.explanation: The people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, and they said they did not know what had become of him.

answers.text: Moses delayed coming down from the mountain

questions.text: What did Aaron tell the people to bring him?
questions.explanation: Aaron said: "Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me."

answers.text: The golden rings in their ears

questions.text: What did Aaron make with the gold?
questions.explanation: Aaron fashioned the gold with an engraving tool and made it a molded calf.

questions.text: Whom did Moses ask God to remember?
questions.explanation: Moses said: "Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants," to whom God had sworn to multiply their offspring.

questions.text: What did Joshua think he heard in the camp?
questions.explanation: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said: "There is the noise of war in the camp."

questions.text: What did Moses do with the tablets when he saw the calf and the dancing?
questions.explanation: Moses' anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands and broke them beneath the mountain.

answers.text: He hid them in a cave
He took them back up the mountain
He threw them down and broke them

questions.text: What did Moses make the Israelites do with the ground-up calf?
questions.explanation: He burned the calf, ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the children of Israel drink it.

answers.text: Carry it out of the camp

questions.text: What excuse did Aaron give for the calf?
questions.explanation: Aaron said: "I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf."

answers.text: Moses had told him to make it
Out of the fire came this calf
The elders made it without him

questions.text: Who gathered to Moses when he asked who was on Yahweh's side?
questions.explanation: Moses said: "Whoever is on Yahweh's side, come to me!" and all the sons of Levi gathered to him.

questions.text: What did Moses ask God to do if he would not forgive the people's sin?
questions.explanation: Moses said: "Forgive their sin - and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written."

answers.text: Blot him out of his book
Let him die in the wilderness
Give the people a new leader
